metadata.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 to FedRAMP CR26 - Unofficial OSCAL Mapping Collection

mapping-description.p: Initial machine-derived control- and statement-level mapping from NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 to FedRAMP CR26 rules and KSIs using CR26 source control references and the NIST OSCAL catalog statement structure. Relationships require human review.
